measured_canonical_raw.note: single venue (BINANCE USD-M perpetual), four fixed contracts: klines whose rows carry the six-field OHLCV shape only, that venue's funding, and its instrument definitions. There is no network/on-chain dataset of any kind - no Bitcoin hash rate, no mining difficulty, no block or miner series - and no BTC/USD (spot dollars) price source; every instrument is quoted and settled in USDT. The raw's own daily history begins 2022-01-01.

matrix.detail: Required data item 1: 'Instrument: Bitcoin (BTC).' The raw holds one BINANCE USD-M perpetual contract on BTC (BTCUSDT), quoted and settled in USDT - not the BTC/USD spot instrument the record's market-data item names.

Required data item 2: 'Timeframe: Daily.' BTCUSDT 1d bars exist: 2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 .. 2026-09-15T00:00:00+00:00, open_time_ms % 86400 == [0, 0, 0] s, uniform step [86400] s, UTC, no partial day.

Required data item 3 (DECISIVE): 'Network Data: Daily Bitcoin Network Hash Rate.' The whole raw tree (1633 entry names, 4 levels) contains no hash-rate/network/mining/difficulty dataset (30 probe tokens, 0 hits); the stored row shapes (kline rows, funding rows, instrument fields) carry no such field; SCHEMA.md documents exactly three dataset families: ['funding', 'instruments', 'klines (Binance USD-M perpetual futures, UTC)'].

Required data item 4: 'Market Data: Daily BTC/USD OHLCV (if using price confirmation filters).' Daily OHLCV exists only as USDT-quoted USD-M perpetual bars for BTCUSDT (local instruments quote/settle in ['USDT']); there is no BTC/USD series and no non-binance path in the raw.
Required data item 5: 'Point-in-time: True historical hash rate data without lookahead bias.' No hash-rate series exists at all, so neither a point-in-time nor a revised variant of one can be read.

The registered decision variable is the 30-day/60-day SMA crossover of the hash rate (capitulation when the 30d crosses below the 60d; buy when it crosses back above). With no hash-rate series the capitulation regimes cannot be counted, dated or evaluated.

Record falsification item 1: 'Backtest over all available Bitcoin history, separating price-driven capitulations from external shock capitulations.' The raw's own daily history is 1718 days (2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00..2026-09-15T00:00:00+00:00) and carries no network series, so the separation the item requires is not expressible at all.

Record signal bullet: 'Price Confirmation: Source indicates waiting for positive price momentum confirmation, but exact indicators are underspecified.' Daily closes exist locally for BTCUSDT; the indicator itself is not registered by the source and cannot be inferred from it.
Record falsification item 2 (first half) is derivable from the local BTCUSDT 1d closes, but only on the local perpetual proxy - it is not the BTC/USD buy-and-hold the record names.
Record falsification item 2 (second half: 'e.g., 200-day SMA crossover') is likewise derivable from local BTCUSDT 1d closes as a price-only proxy.

Record falsification item 4: 'Test the signal with and without the price momentum confirmation filter to isolate the value of the network data vs. simple price trend.' The network leg of the ablation cannot be constructed, so the contrast the item defines has no left-hand side.

The record's 'Execution assumptions' section (present in the canonical record, not excerpted in the frozen card body) marks Execution Timing, Market Type, Slippage & Impact and Fees all 'Underspecified'; the inherited A/B invariant fixes linear USD-M perpetuals instead, which is disclosed rather than silently resolved.

The record leaves Fees/Slippage 'Underspecified'. The raw's instrument export carries maker_fee/taker_fee/price_increment for the four local perpetuals only, so the card's cost rule (canonical instrument metadata, 1 tick adverse baseline, 2 ticks robustness) is executable for those four contracts and for nothing else.
